title: Development-card timing switches under the learned tables leaf
source: Engine-arena swapped pairs of 512 games each on deterministic boards played once per rotation, the candidate and the control in slots 0 and 1 in both seatings; the builders lineup (L1) seats an ETA and a fast builder beside the searches, the population lineup (L2) a third tables search and an ETA. Each point is the per-seed half-difference of the two slot-0-minus-slot-1 contrasts of a pair with its 95% interval over 64 boards. Runs: f97d8683, 176f12e2; 3292674f, a86a5e49; ea42e55d, 64bbd775; c5ffb6cf, 4a18f4f2; 30180b9b, e6c5fbd4; 873ab9ef, 08636046; d493c5b4, 8a8b0ffb; b41de3cf, 41c8da11; 8263d242, e3fc4a9c; a6afd7a8, 5046ec2d.
caption: Each point is one swapped pair’s seating-corrected effect in wins per game with its 95% interval over boards; the two candidate-rule arms play under the tables alone, the knight-value arm under the named blend.
